open_points.subject: execute_function environment
open_points.text: the environment never receives a credential, a host path other than its own exchange directory and the read-only runtime the next note binds (A03 rule 1, decision 25), or any variable outside the imported SANDBOX_ENVIRONMENT constant.
open_points.other_text: bubblewrap adds PWD after --clearenv and the interpreter's C-locale coercion adds a locale variable, so clearing at launch alone leaves both
open_points.question: Must the environment never receive variables outside SANDBOX_ENVIRONMENT, or may PWD and a locale variable exist until the runner clears them?

open_points.subject: execute_function scratch bound
open_points.text: one fresh private exchange directory bound read-write and bounded by the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SANDBOX_SCRATCH_BYTES_MAX constant
open_points.other_text: the size of a file written in the scratch with setrlimit
open_points.question: Must the constant bound the aggregate exchange directory, or only each individual file written there?

open_points.subject: execute_function process bound
open_points.text: The parent MUST enforce bounds from outside:
open_points.other_text: the outer process bound is the setrlimit limit on the number of processes at bounds.process_count + 1, set by the runner inside the sandbox's user namespace before it loads the code
open_points.question: Must the outer process bound be enforced by the parent from outside, or set by the runner inside the sandbox?
